options.formula:
DATEADD(
  DATETIME_PARSE(
    DATETIME_FORMAT({fldMwTtDRNvAClu5n}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm'),
    'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm'
  ),
  660 - (
    (VALUE(MID(ARRAYJOIN({fldduMKDFa2BfkpAb}), 5, 2)) * 60 +
     VALUE(MID(ARRAYJOIN({fldduMKDFa2BfkpAb}), 8, 2)))
    * IF(MID(ARRAYJOIN({fldduMKDFa2BfkpAb}), 4, 1) = "+", 1, -1)
  ),
  'minutes'
)
